incidents.name: BITDOG public changeRouterVersion()
incidents.notes: changeRouterVersion() is public (the onlyOwner restriction is only a comment), so the attacker swapped in a fake router and pair and made swapAndLiquify forward the token's whole BNB balance to itself.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x4bbb53252b0cee84e6824e85989ea2eddeec25f1 created 2022-04-09T04:45:52Z by 0x55198f3ea9e10479790cfe190e7d9590561b0dbe, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x7b6a1f878bf29430788e743ee149ed2a3202f136; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 2.10 BNB x $599.85/BNB at the incident timestamp 1745767843 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,260.
